newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia prostitutes, barman die in rebel shootout.
newsitem.headline: Colombia prostitutes, barman die in rebel shootout.

text.p: Four prostitutes and a barman died in crossfire during a gunfight between leftist guerrillas and soldiers in southern Colombia, El Tiempo newspaper reported on Monday.

The women were sitting outside a bar in the town of Hobo, in Huila province, on Saturday evening when rebels ambushed a passing police patrol with dynamite. A gunfight broke out when the dynamite failed to kill the policemen and they responded by shooting at the guerrillas, who returned fire.
The prostitutes, who had been waiting for clients, were riddled with bullets, El Tiempo said. The barman died of his injuries in a hospital later. None of the policemen was killed.

The bar owner, who had been talking to the women outside, escaped death because he ran indoors to watch his favourite TV show, Baywatch, El Tiempo said. The attack was blamed on the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's oldest and largest rebel army.
